name: 75247 · Dallas, TX
findings: ZIP 75247 (Dallas) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75247 (Dallas) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75247 (Dallas) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 21.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
